question: bulk RNA-seq of human cells treated with an mTOR inhibitor such as Torin1 or rapamycin compared with vehicle

plan.ideal_summary: Bulk RNA-seq analysis of human cell lines or primary cells treated with the mTOR inhibitor Torin1 or rapamycin compared to vehicle control. The study measures global transcriptomic changes in response to mTOR pathway inhibition. Samples include untreated controls and inhibitor-treated groups to identify differentially expressed genes associated with mTOR signaling.
method_notes: Bulk RNA-seq measures average gene expression across the cell population, masking cell-type-specific responses if the sample is heterogeneous.
Torin1 inhibits both mTORC1 and mTORC2, while rapamycin primarily inhibits mTORC1; datasets should specify the inhibitor used to interpret pathway-specific effects.
Time-course data is valuable as mTOR inhibition effects can be rapid (translation) or delayed (transcriptional), so single time-point data may miss dynamic changes.
plan.geo_query: ("mTOR inhibitor"[Title] OR "Torin1"[Title] OR "rapamycin"[Title] OR "mTORC1"[Title] OR "mTORC2"[Title] OR "mTOR signaling"[Title] OR "mTOR inhibitor"[Description] OR "Torin1"[Description] OR "rapamycin"[Description] OR "mTORC1"[Description] OR "mTORC2"[Description] OR "mTOR signaling"[Description]) AND ("vehicle"[Description] OR "control"[Description] OR "untreated"[Description] OR "DMSO"[Description])
